UU., Donald Trump, lanzó varias advertencias de índole internacional: el republicano aseguró que sopesa entre permitir la reconstrucción de Irán o "aniquilarlos" y "llevarlos al infierno", sostuvo que su país controlará la seguridad de Groenlandia, afirmó que Cuba es un "Estado fallido" que "va a caer". item.title: Un año después, palestinos y judios reaccionan a reconocimiento de Francia de un Estado palestino
item.description: En la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas del 2025, el presidente de Francia, Emmanuel Macron, reconoció la existencia de un Estado palestino junto a Canadá, Australia, Reino Unido y Portugal. Era la primera vez que países del G7 daban este paso. Sin embargo, la decisión se volvió crucial dada la ofensiva israelí en la Franja de Gaza y el avance de los asentamientos en Cisjordania. Desde París, nuestra periodista, Erika Olavarría, habló con algunas personas de la comunidad palestina en Francia, quienes exigen más acciones. Por su parte, el pueblo judio, sigue rechazando las declaraciones. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him
item.description: US president may have upstaged the ghost of Soviet leader Khrushchev by musing destruction of fellow member state Donald Trump has a habit of discomfiting delegates to the United Nations general assembly. But this year, he may have upstaged the ghost of former Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev by openly contemplating the annihilation of a fellow UN member state. Eleven minutes into a 40-minute address, the US president announced he had “a big decision to make” over Iran, which has staged a much more determined resistance than Trump anticipated when he decided to go to war against the country in… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Trump's world? Leaders navigate consequences of US policy
item.description: A year ago, Donald Trump went to the rostrum of the United Nations General Assembly - and after taxing an axe to US aid and development funding, read the world the riot act. One Iran war later, the US president sticking to script with a speech that borrowed much of the language of last year. With citizens on five continents now feeling the pain at the pump, we'll ask what it will take to tame a global energy crisis whose potential spiral mirrors the contagion of hostilities from the Strait of Hormuz to the mouth of the Red Sea? Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Iran, AI and the ICC: Trump makes threats, touts policies at UN General Assembly
item.description: US President Donald Trump launched a full-throated defence of the deeply unpopular US-Israeli war against Iran before the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, claiming that Washington would reach a deal with Tehran after the upcoming US midterm elections. Trump also rejected the idea of global regulation of artificial intelligence, said the government of Cuba would soon "fall", and urged member countries of the International Criminal Court to "resign". Fuente: France 24 - English.
